modern_gold_meta.register_caveat: UD-EWT is MODERN WEB TEXT (blogs, reviews, email, newsgroups), NOT children's narrative. This set tests CONSTRUCTION handling, NOT register transfer to McGuffey-style narrative. Register difference is a real confound for any cross-corpus generalization claim; state it.
modern_gold_meta.label_derivation: who-is-affected label = (verb_lemma, patient_head) DERIVED FROM THE GOLD PARSE ONLY (obj / obl / nsubj:pass / obl:agent edges). INDEPENDENT of our reader and of any semantic/plausibility cue. No hand-invented sentences; all sentences are real UD-EWT items selected by gold-parse pattern.

mcguffey_gold_meta.corpus: McGuffey Third Reader (PG#14766, public domain), lessons L04,L05,L07,L08,L09,L10,L12 (clean narrative prose; L06 title-only + L11 blacksmith poem excluded).
mcguffey_gold_meta.independence: Annotated by reading the raw McGuffey sentence text and writing the TRUE argument structure per sentence. The point of this gold is to mark, per verb-INSTANCE, whether it takes a direct affected/created/perceived PATIENT (pos) or takes NO direct patient (nopat: intransitive-motion / cognition-clausal / oblique-perception / report / copular / aspectual). The reader's extraction output was used ONLY to key which sentence-ids exist; the pos/nopat argument-structure judgments are the annotator's own reading of the text (ground truth), independent of what the reader extracted. Keyed to deterministic sentence ids (split_sents on the lessons).
mcguffey_gold_meta.standard: pos relation = (v_lemma, agent_head, patient_head) where an AGENT acts on / creates / perceives a distinct PATIENT/THEME ENTITY. Heads are surface tokens (pronouns kept). nopat instance = (v_lemma, agent_head) for a verb occurrence that licenses NO direct patient: intransitive self-motion (come/go/sit/stand/fall/run/walk/spring/leap/creep/swim), cognition/clausal-complement (think/know/wonder/mean/wish/hope/believe/see-that/find-that/fear/suppose/choose/prefer/intend/learn), oblique/perception-AT (look-at/tread-on/struggle-against/meddle-with/fire-on/reach-for/inquire-about), report/speech (say/said/cry[exclaim]/ask/answer/retort/tell[recipient+clause]/call[summon]/exclaim/speak), aspectual (begin/commence/try/continue-of-motion), copular/light-idiom (do-no-harm/get-finished). A verb-instance is in EXACTLY one of pos or nopat (or absent if not annotated). EXCLUDED entirely (neither): passives with no expressed agent, bare copulas, embedded infinitive objects, gerund-internal objects, quantifier-only 'nothing/nobody' patients, ambiguous idioms.
mcguffey_gold_meta.usage: PRIMARY precision/recall over pos (v_lemma, patient) patient-level. SUBCAT TRUE-NEGATIVE: over nopat verb-instances the reader mis-attached a patient to, does an arm SUPPRESS the wrong patient (correct) vs keep it (subcat FP). WITHIN-FRAME FP: reader keeps a wrong patient on a verb whose pos set is non-empty. refs = agent coref surfaces for the lenient-agent triple metric only.
mcguffey_gold_meta.caveat: SINGLE-ANNOTATOR gold; the pos-vs-nopat boundary involves judgment calls (rub-against/knit-forehead/nod-head counted as pos contact/body-part per the sibling v1 gold convention; look-at/tread-on/struggle-against counted nopat oblique). Full gold + full reader output + all matches are reported in metrics so a VET can independently re-annotate the same sentences and recompute.
mcguffey_gold_meta.characters: Herbert(he/his/him), Joe(he/him), papa/Mr.Rose(he), Hetty(she/her), pussy=cat(she/her/it), Charles(he/him), James(he/him), Frank(he/him), the gardener(he), mother/mamma(she/her), father(he), the castle/block/kite/hut(it).
